ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central region. A prominent vertical low-intensity streak is located on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge boundary; 12 distinct peaks on the left lobe and 14 on the right lobe with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 18 pixels.
